'''Víctor Felipe Paredes Guerra''' (20 April 1944 – 26 January 2022) was a Peruvian academic and politician.

==Biography==
A member of [[Cambio 90]] and the [[Popular Force]], he served in the [[Congress of the Republic of Peru]] from 1990 to 1992 and was its [[President of the Congress of the Republic of Peru|President]] from 1990 to 1991.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.congreso.gob.pe/museo/presidentes/310.VictorFelipe_ParedesGuerra.pdf|title=Víctor Felipe Paredes Guerra|work=Congreso de la República del Perú|language=es|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403153011/http://www4.congreso.gob.pe/museo/presidentes/310.VictorFelipe_ParedesGuerra.pdf|archivedate=3 April 2016}}</ref> He was also [[Ministry of Health (Peru)|Minister of Health]] from 1991 to 1993. 

He died from [[COVID-19]] in [[Lima]] on 26 January 2022, at the age of 77.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=26 January 2022|title=Falleció Víctor Paredes Guerra, excongresista y exministro de Salud|trans-title= |url=https://rpp.pe/politica/actualidad/fallecio-victor-paredes-guerra-excongresista-y-exministro-de-salud-noticia-1383053|language=es|work=[[Radio Programas del Perú]]|location= |access-date=28 January 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rpp.pe/politica/actualidad/fallecio-victor-paredes-guerra-excongresista-y-exministro-de-salud-noticia-1383053|title=Falleció Víctor Paredes Guerra, excongresista y exministro de Salud|date=26 January 2022}}</ref>
